description: Final evaluation artifacts and the packaged LIBERO planner adapter. Large policy checkpoints remain external; the LIBERO Qwen LoRA is tracked with Git LFS.

robotwin_pi05_subtask.role: Shared RoboTwin subtask pi0.5 action backend

notes: Relative paths are relative to the OmniRoboAgent repository.
Environment-backed paths identify external model stores without embedding machine-specific paths.
The RoboTwin report uses the shared 20000_pytorch checkpoint, not a task-specialist checkpoint.
The LIBERO report is direct subtask VLA-only evaluation with the 005000 adapter; no Qwen planner was used in that run.
The packaged LIBERO Qwen planner LoRA is included for integrated planner experiments and is not the source of the reported 95.20% direct VLA score.
